gameDescriptionHtml:
In every woman’s life, there comes a moment when she walks into the wrong door… The last thing I remember is a masquerade party at a nightclub and a tall, muscular man with a Belarusian accent who offered to buy me a cocktail…

Maria is a free girl, definitely of legal drinking age in any country. She heads to a masquerade party dressed as a bunny. Vitaly, by a stroke of luck, happens to be at the same club, sets his eyes on her, and offers to buy her a tasty drink. For unknown reasons, Maria loses consciousness, and Vitaly, being a true gentleman, places her limp body in the trunk and takes her to his country residence to let her have a good sleep. Upon waking up, Maria realizes that Vitaly brought her to his place. But she’s not that kind of girl. So she firmly decides that she needs to escape at any cost… But for free!

You need to sneak away from Vitaly’s country residence in a luxurious silver Haval. Unlock doors, break planks, open electrical panels, smash floors, throw dishes, distract Vitaly with loud noises, and enjoy PS4-era graphics!

Game Features

  • Randomized placement of items needed to escape this evil residence!
  • A mysterious admirer chasing you no matter where you hide.
  • A seductive heroine who leaves no one indifferent.
  • Multiple escape routes planned. Eventually.
  • Easter eggs galore!
  • Real reflections in mirrors! When was the last time you saw that?
  • You can hide in the toilet.
  • Become successful and rich!
